design: Filesystem-backed canonical units at boot, through the registered server leaves only. matchUnitBootstrap.ts gains deriveServerAdaptedUnits and recoverServerInteractiveSession: catalog units are read synchronously with getNodeCanonicalUnitService().getByIdSync and adapted with the same adaptUnitFromData the engine uses; custom units (recorded snapshot or custom- ref) keep the engine path (deriveAdaptedUnitsFromSession with readServerCustomCombatDefinition), so snapshot validation and fail-closed custom behaviour are byte-identical; the session is adopted with InteractiveSession.fromHydratedSession using the same reseed rule as fromSessionAsync (finite config.seed -> SeededRandom + SeededD6Roller, else SeededRandom(0xc0ffee) and the default roller). MatchRecovery.ts routes its three fromSessionAsync call sites (rebuildSessionFromEvents, registerRecoveredHost, the activated-rewind arm) to recoverServerInteractiveSession. server.js boot order, src/engine, CanonicalUnitService.ts and NodeCanonicalUnitService.ts are unchanged. matchUnitBootstrap.ts is already server-only (server registry graph); no browser module imports it.
